en: Ah, anything will do.
Well, well. That's unusual.
Folks with money usually go next door
to the saloon...
The two bars share a building, but rich
and poor use different doors and rooms.
The saloon's a posh place. No poor allowed.
And this pub here is the cheap bar where
anyone can drink.
Care for another?
Oh, it's you, sir. You came back again.
The drunks in here can't keep their
hands to themselves... Vulgar, the lot of 'em.
Gentlemen like you, sir,
are few and far between.
I work at this place, you see,
because the pay's a bit better than elsewhere.
I ran up a little debt,
and I work here to pay it off.
Besides, there's some nice extra income.
Here, have another.
The world's full of drunks who love their booze.
But you know, drunks aren't so bad.
After all, it's so easy to lift their wallets.
So that's your "extra income."
Well, yes.
But don't worry.
I haven't touched your wallet.
I would never be so careless
as to let myself be robbed.
Once I've paid off all my debts, I'm saying
goodbye to this joint.
And what will you do once you quit?
You know, I want to be an actress.
That's why I came to this city.
Everyone who comes to the big city brings
a dream along with them.
You did too, didn't you?
If it's about the rent, please wait a bit longer.
Huh? You're not the landlady?
Oh, I was sure it was that old
landlady.
I'm Nellie.
I work at the pub. Nice to meet you.
Oh, I wish I could get out of debt already.
As long as I work at the pub, I'll never want for drink,
or so I'd think.
Fancy a drink in my room?
I've got something special put by...
Let's have a drink together again.
Nellie.
Who's there? Let me sleep a little longer.
...Nighty...
night...
Passed out drunk, is she?
Then I shall help myself as she lies.
Mmm...
Not there.
Don't...
Your blood shall now be mine...
I'm Nellie.
I work at the pub.
Oh, why does gin always hit me so hard,
I wonder...
My head hurts.
Why does gin always make me so sick,
I wonder...
note: Shared with Clio msgs 402166/402612: M2#10436 must end with a comma clause that 'I wonder...' completes.

en: Another hangover today...
Let's have a drink together again sometime.
Maybe I drank too much today...
I may not look it, but I can barely stand.
I work at the pub, you know.
Living in debt is just awful, isn't it?
I want to be free, and soon.
Oh, I've gone and gotten completely
drunk again today.
I can't wait to get to my bed and rest.
Yes, any drink is fine by me.
Folks dressed as finely as you
note: Continues in M2#9840 (slice 123): 'usually go to the saloon next door...'.
